name: rollcall_payphone
about: Roll call: classname npc_payphone builds CPayphone (factory 0x101aa550, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). One row taken verbatim from sm_diner_1 (SMphone). CPayphone::NPCThink (slot 431, 0x101aabf0; docs/vtmb/npc-ai/lifecycle.md) never calls CAI_BaseNPCTroika::NPCThink: a payphone runs no schedule, no senses and no motor; with no dialogue partner it sets ACT_IDLE and rethinks every 0.25 s. So retail installs no program at all: no schedule, no task, no failure, for the whole ten seconds.
